messages:
Maya Chen: Quick FYI — opened a docs PR to clarify APAC region availability and the data residency footnote: https://github.com/redwood-inference/docs/pull/4861. Main change is a clearer table and a short migration note for Dedicated->Private customers.
Liam O'Connor: Nice! Can you paste the SDK snippet you updated? want to check the region param naming for the JS SDK.
Maya Chen: sure — current snippet in PR (JS):
```js
const client = new Redwood({ apiKey: process.env.RW_KEY, region: 'asia-south1' })
const res = await client.generate({ model: 'redwood/claim-v1', input: 'Hello' })
```
I changed the comment to call out that region != data residency (only Private with region pinning guarantees residency).
Sofia Patel: +1 on being explicit. A user filed a ticket that the docs implied hosted API could do data residency in APAC — we need a sentence: "Hosted API responds from closest region but does not guarantee data residency; use Private for residency guarantees." short and bold?
Maya Chen: added that exact sentence in the PR under the Region availability section. also added a footnote linking to /compliance/data-residency.
Arjun Desai: Deploy preview failed for the PR because of a broken relative link in the migration guide — ci log: `ERROR 404 /docs/migrate/dedicated-to-private.md -> /compliance/`
deploy-bot: preview build #4861 failed — linkcheck error at /migrate/dedicated-to-private.md (line 42).
Maya Chen: thanks — fixed the relative URL to absolute `/compliance/data-residency` and pushed a commit. Also added an explicit note in the migration guide about exporting logs for customers switching from Dedicated to Private.
Liam O'Connor: One more SDK ask — our Python snippet uses `region="ap-southeast-1"` but the SDK expects region slug `asia-sg1`. Can we normalize the example to use the canonical slugs and add a short mapping table?
Maya Chen: good catch — adding a small table under "Region slugs in SDK" with examples and a link to the model routing page.
Sofia Patel: I'll approve once the table and the compliance link are in. Also can we add a one-line changelog snippet so customers see what's new in the docs release?
Maya Chen: added CHANGELOG entry to /docs/CHANGELOG.md and updated the PR description.
Arjun Desai: CI green on latest commit, preview looks good — region table renders responsively now.
deploy-bot: preview build #4861 succeeded — linkcheck passed.
Liam O'Connor: thanks all. after merge, we should send a short blurb to #region-availability with the footnote text to reduce support tickets.
Maya Chen: will do — drafting a short Slack blurb and a one-line example for the SDK README. Anyone want to review the blurb before I post?
Sofia Patel: send it here and I'll quick review. :thumbsup:
